gates.name: production-smoke
command: ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCAL_DEV=1 PORT=31342 npm start >/tmp/ragbot-proofline-server.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; i=0; until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:31342/health >/tmp/ragbot-proofline-health.json && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:31342/ >/tmp/ragbot-proofline-home.html; do i=$((i+1)); test $i -lt 30 || { cat /tmp/ragbot-proofline-server.log; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done; jq -e '.ok == true and .accessControlConfigured == true' /tmp/ragbot-proofline-health.json >/dev/null; rg -q '<title>Tom the Peep - Floyd Vision Agent</title>' /tmp/ragbot-proofline-home.html
